skills.name: serein-optane-wsl
skills.description: Load before any Serein compile, build, test, cargo, go test, git fetch or worktree, or WSL job on Win11 DESKTOP-C4JG869. Windows work lives on O: (Git Bash, O:\Serein). Linux work lives on P: as FedoraLinux-43 user SR. GitHub is the only path between them: each side runs git fetch; no /mnt, no \\wsl$, no files over wsl.exe stdin. Call WSL with --exec, never --. Test branches and one-shot worktrees are deleted when the test ends. Use when compiling or testing Serein, fetching github.com/ARYYDS/Serein-ARC, adding worktrees, or the user runs /serein-optane-wsl.
skills.when_to_use: Serein compile, build, test, cargo build/check/test, go build/test/vet, musl, WSL, wsl.exe, FedoraLinux-43, user SR, O: drive, P: drive, Optane, git worktree, git fetch, test branch, CARGO_TARGET_DIR, GOCACHE, 9P, /mnt, Git Bash, pwsh quoting, SSH to Win11, long build over 10 minutes, /serein-optane-wsl, 编译, 构建, 测试, 多分支, 删分支

skills.name: clipboard-repair
skills.description: Diagnose and fix Windows clipboard CJK mojibake (GBK/UTF-8 bytes shown as Latin-1/CP1252 in Win+V). Use when Chinese copied from Grok, a TUI, clip.exe, OSC 52, PowerShell stdin, or agent output pastes as garbled CJK; when CF_TEXT/CF_UNICODETEXT mismatch; keywords 剪贴板乱码, 复制中文乱码, GROK_CLIPBOARD_NO_OSC52, /clipboard-repair.
skills.when_to_use: clipboard mojibake, CF_TEXT, OSC 52, Win+V, 剪贴板乱码, 复制中文乱码, GROK_CLIPBOARD_NO_OSC52, /clipboard-repair
